# KOVO-KUKY: CNC machining in South Bohemia

> Family-owned contract CNC machining shop in Dolní Bukovsko, Czech Republic. CNC turning, 3-axis milling and bar cutting of steel, stainless steel, aluminium, brass and technical plastics. Tolerances of ±0.01 mm, quotation within 48 hours, orders from one piece. Customers in the Czech Republic, Germany, Austria and Slovakia. Czech and German spoken.

## Facts
- Company: KOVO-KUKY, Václav Kukačka (sole proprietor)
- In business since: 1990 (family business, second generation runs it)
- Address: Veselská 58, 373 65 Dolní Bukovsko, Czech Republic
- Company ID (IČO): 721 80 714, VAT ID: CZ8011251237
- Team: 6 people
- Opening hours: Monday to Friday, 07:00 to 16:00
- Phone: +420 725 770 820, Email: info@kovokuky.cz
- Languages: Czech, German

## Services
- CNC turning: parts up to Ø 400 mm and 600 mm long on Doosan Lynx 220 (2x), Goodway GLS-200 and GLS-150 with Fanuc control
- CNC milling: 3-axis centres XHS (travel 800×500×500 mm) and Robodrill (700×400×330 mm)
- Material cutting: Bianco band saws, bars and profiles up to Ø 260 mm, angled cuts
- Zinc plating, welding and surface treatments through vetted partners
